title: Connect Amplitude to the SEO loop
body:
URL: /
Cluster: setup:amplitude
Type: technical
Source: SEO plan step 7

## Why
Step 7 of the plan (focus on conversions) needs per-page App Store clicks. The site already sends `app_store_click`, `tool_input` and autocaptured page views to Amplitude, but the agent cannot read them yet.

## Do
1. Open the Composio Amplitude link and connect the Blou Amplitude project (alias `blou`).
2. Run `npm run seo:conversions` and check the top pages look right.
3. Commit `seo/data/amplitude/latest.json`.

## Done when
`npm run seo:conversions` prints per-page App Store clicks.

title: Add Google Ads Keyword Planner keys to .env.local
body:
URL: /
Cluster: setup:keyword-planner
Type: technical
Source: SEO plan step 2

## Why
Weekly research needs search volume. The Google Ads account and OAuth client used by the AniDachi CRM already work; Blou can reuse them.

## Do
Add to `.env.local` (never commit): `GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN`, `GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID` (8078204641), `GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN`. Values are in the AniDachi `apps/web/.env.local` and `apps/web/crm-data/google-ads-tokens.json`.

## Done when
`npm run seo:keywords -- "quit smoking app"` prints ideas with monthly searches.

title: Decide on SERP and screenshot APIs (DataForSEO, ScreenshotOne)
body:
URL: /
Cluster: setup:serp-screenshot
Type: technical
Source: SEO plan step 1

## Why
The article recommends DataForSEO for SERP data and ScreenshotOne for screenshots. Today the agent reads SERPs through the browser and captures screenshots by hand, which works but is slower and less reliable in a scheduled run.

## Do
Create accounts if wanted, connect them in Composio, and add the tool names to `.claude/skills/seo-opportunity-research/SKILL.md` and `seo-blog-writer/SKILL.md`.

## Done when
Research runs pull top-5 SERP results without the browser.

title: Schedule the SEO loop (research, writer, audit, conversions)
body:
URL: /
Cluster: setup:schedule
Type: technical
Source: SEO plan steps 2-6

## Do
Create the four scheduled tasks from `seo/README.md` (Loop schedule section). Start with `SEO_PUBLISH_MODE=pr` so every article lands as a PR you merge.

## Done when
The Monday research run has created issues on its own once.

title: Add App Store CTAs to pages that have none
body:
URL: /vape-withdrawal-symptoms
Cluster: conversion:missing-cta
Type: conversion
Source: seo/data/inventory.json issue `no-app-cta`

## Evidence
The inventory flags 2 article pages with zero `data-event="app_store_click"` links: `/vape-withdrawal-symptoms` (170 impressions/28d) and `/quit-vaping-timeline`. Neither imports `AppCta`.

## Do
Add `InlineAppCta` after the first useful section and `EndAppCta` with `campaign="article_<slug>"`.

## Done when
Rebuilt inventory shows no `no-app-cta` issues.

title: Link /about from the footer or guides hub

## Evidence

## Done when
Inventory `linkedFrom` for `/about` is above 0.

title: Rewrite title and meta for /guides/diarrhea (579 impressions, 0.35% CTR)
body:
URL: /guides/diarrhea
Cluster: diarrhea after quitting smoking
Type: ctr-snippet
Source: GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24

## Evidence
579 impressions, 2 clicks, CTR 0.35%, average position 8.6 (previous 28 days: 16 impressions). This is the site's highest-impression page. Meta description is 183 chars (cut off in results) and the title does not contain the exact phrase the page targets.

## Recommended action
Snippet review plus a sharper quick answer. Low ranking risk: the page gets almost no clicks today. Keep the URL. Title ≤ 60 chars leading with the answer (how long it lasts), meta 140-155 chars with a concrete duration and a reason to click.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief (job type: snippet review + refresh of the top section)

## Done when
QA PASS, live, and CTR checked again 3 weeks after publish.

title: Win the pack-year cluster on /tools/pack-year-calculator (positions 50-70)
body:
URL: /tools/pack-year-calculator
Cluster: pack year calculator
Type: refresh
Source: GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24

## Evidence
283 impressions, 0 clicks, position 55. At least 12 distinct pack-year queries appeared this window ("pack year calculator", "pack years", "how to work out pack years", "pack year history calculator", "smoking pack years calculator"...). Google is testing the page for the whole cluster but it ranks too low.

## Recommended action
Refresh the tool page: answer "how to calculate pack years" (formula + worked example) above the fold, add a table of common values, FAQ for lung-screening thresholds (USPSTF 20 pack-years, cite it), and links from /smokers-lungs-vs-healthy-lungs, /can-lungs-heal-after-smoking, /quitting-smoking-after-50. Check Keyword Planner volume for the cluster first.

Type: internal-links
Source: GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24

## Evidence
"vaping withdrawal timeline" (pos 79.5), "how long does it take to quit vaping" (pos 73.2) show /vape-withdrawal-symptoms, not /quit-vaping-timeline, which is the page built for timeline intent.
